item.title: Reynard v0.14.1
item.description:
Reynard 0.14.1 | Reynard
## Changes
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.14.0...0.14.1
This is a minor release that fixes issues found in 0.14.0. For the complete list of changes, see the [0.14.0 release notes](https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/releases/tag/0.14.0).
### Bug Fixes & Improvements - Fixed a crash when opening Reader Mode settings on some older iOS versions. - Fixed the system serif font not being looked up correctly on webpages and in Reader Mode. - Fixed a misleading JIT enablement banner appearing on jailbroken iOS 17.4 and later. - Fixed media playback not resuming automatically after interruptions such as dictation.

item.title: Table Habit v1.27.9
item.description:
Table Habit 1.27.9 | mhabit-unsigned
# Release: v1.27.9+198
> Includes updates since the previous stable release, v1.27.6+195.
## ✨ Features
- Cycle check-ins from unknown to done, skipped, and back to unknown (#657) - Delete a single check-in or several at once with confirmation - Sync deletions across devices and keep record identity for later check-ins - Improve dialogs and page layouts across window sizes (#661) - Adapt sheets and dialogs when resizing while preserving the open form and navigation state - Migrate group management, sync editing, changelog, donation, and about dialogs to shared adaptive presentation - Keep nested navigation and close confirmation within the active dialog - Align scrolling page headers, safe areas, and window-control avoidance - Improve habit detail actions and refresh retained details when returning to them (#662) - Improve Settings, grouped lists, and dialogs across window sizes (#663) - Add date format, reminder, export, import progress, and group editing flows - Keep import results and group actions tied to the selected items - Preserve unknown WebDAV fields when syncing groups and records, improving compatibility with newer app versions (#665)
## 🐛 Fixes
- Restore batch check-in actions for selected habits in Apple layouts (#661) - Preserve Settings scroll position when rebuilding the page (#661) - Prevent a delayed group save from closing the group selector after the user has already returned from the creation form (#661) - Improve loading error recovery (#662) - Bound import concurrency and expose failures for individual items (#663)
## 🌐 Localization
- Update Italian translation, thanks to Simone De Carli's contribution on Weblate (#664)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/FriesI23/mhabit/compare/v1.27.6+195...v1.27.9+198)

item.title: Reynard v0.14.0
item.description:
Reynard 0.14.0 | Reynard
## Changes **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/minh-ton/reynard-browser/compare/0.13.1...0.14.0
### New Features - Added Reader Mode. - Added preliminary support for Apple Pencil.
### Bug Fixes & Improvements - Improved the reliability of navigation history restoration on startup. - Fixed taps and the text cursor sometimes landing in the wrong spot on pages with sticky headers or menus. - Fixed pinned headers, footers, and menus sometimes showing up in the wrong place when the toolbar size changes or during scrolling. - Fixed pages sometimes settling in the wrong spot after a jump, zoom, or reload, which left part of the page hidden behind the toolbar. - Fixed an issue where webpages could open with the wrong light or dark appearance on startup when the appearance chosen in Settings differs from the system's. - Fixed a crash that could occur during audio playback.
### Engine Updated Gecko to [156.0](https://github.com/mozilla-firefox/firefox/commit/FIREFOX_156_0_RELEASE) (released Sep 15, 2026).

item.title: Mangayomi v0.9.6
item.description:
Mangayomi 0.9.6 | Mangayomi-v0.9.6-ios
# What's New
## 📖 Reader & Manga
* **Intelligent Double-Page Spreads & RTL Reading** (#1018, #1008): * Wide and landscape double-page spreads are now shown seamlessly on their own full-width screen instead of being awkwardly paired with single pages. * Switching between single and double-page view, rotating your device, or changing reading modes no longer resets your progress back to chapter 1. * Resuming chapters in Right-to-Left (manga) reading mode now starts in the correct direction without layout flipping. * **Instant Border Cropping & Cache Improvements**: * Turning border crop on or off in Webtoon / continuous reading now applies instantly without re-downloading the images. * Fixed an issue where resuming a chapter at a saved page could cause an infinite loading spinner for already cached images. * **Smoother Reading Experience**: * Fixed page flickering and display glitches when scrolling quickly through continuous chapters.
---
## Novel Reader
* **Scroll-Free E-Reader Paged Mode** (#1019): * Read novels like a real book with page-turning swipes and taps instead of endless vertical scrolling. * Quickly switch between **Continuous Scroll** and **Paged Reading** directly from the novel settings sheet. * **Single & Double-Page Column Layouts** (#1019): * Added single-page and side-by-side double-page reading modes, optimized for tablets, foldable devices, and landscape screens. * Settings sheet changes (reading mode, page mode) are now applied and previewed instantly.
---
## Video Player & Anime
* **Player Screen Lock (Mobile)**: * Added a dedicated screen lock button to the mobile controls to prevent accidental touches while watching. * When locked, all on-screen controls, touch gestures (swiping to seek, volume/brightness, double-tap jump, 2x speed hold), and the skip button are completely disabled. * Protects against accidentally exiting the player with the back button or back gesture. * Tap anywhere on the locked screen to display a quick-unlock button in the top-left corner. * **Cleaner Seek Indicator**: * Simplified and streamlined the swipe-to-seek visual overlay on the player.
---
## Features & User Experience
* **Smoother Category Management**: * Reordering categories in settings is now much more responsive and intuitive using dedicated drag handles. * **Details Header Polish**: * Improved visual layout and formatting in the manga/anime details header.
---
## Fixes & Stability
* **Reliable Background Sync**: * Fixed occasional crashes and errors that could occur when closing screens or navigating away during library synchronization.
---
## Localization
* Added translations for the new player screen lock feature across all supported languages.
---
## Contributors
* @kodjodevf * @jikkun (#1018, #1019)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/kodjodevf/mangayomi/compare/v0.9.5...v0.9.6

item.title: Manic EMU v2.0.1
item.description:
Manic EMU 2.0.1 | ManicEMU.v2.0.1.SideloadJIT
- Added WonderSwan support - Added NAOMI, Atomiswave, and System SP arcade support - Added Flash support · Skin button binding · Hardware keyboard input · Software keyboard input · Touch input - Built-in, self-contained JIT — no external debugger required - Added Slow Motion - Improved GameCube and Wii performance - GameCube now supports multi-disc games - Improved Wii motion controls - Simulate the Wii IR pointer by touch - Add games from other emulators via a link - Fixed some arcade systems that wouldn’t run - Fixed Dreamcast games running too fast - Fixed PSP crashes - Added NDS lid open/close - Improved rotation: with orientation lock on in Control Center, the app no longer snaps back to portrait - In-game shortcut tips can now be turned off - Landscape library can disable carousel style - Smoother landscape carousel scrolling - MultiDisc Helper supports more formats - Hardware keyboard input for Symbian, Amiga, and C64 - Added RomM support · LAN self-hosted servers only · Sync only for games imported from RomM · Manual sync only, from the service card’s long-press menu · Pull ROMs, covers, metadata, manuals, and game saves - Fixed a launch timeout that could quit the app on older devices - N64 now supports ROMs larger than 64 MB
